an4.171:1.1: [sāvatthiyaṃ] kāye vā bhikkhave sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:1.2: vācāya vā bhikkhave sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:1.3: mane vā bhikkhave sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. avijjāpaccayā va.
an4.171:2.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:2.2: pare vāssa taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:2.3: sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:2.4: asampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:3.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:3.2: pare vāssa taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti,
an4.171:3.3: yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:3.4: sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:3.5: asampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:4.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ bhikkhave manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:4.2: pare vāssa taṃ bhikkhave manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:4.3: sampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:4.4: asampajāno vā taṃ bhikkhave manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
an4.171:5.2: avijjāyatveva asesavirāganirodhā so kāyo na hoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. sā vācā na hoti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. so mano na hoti yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ -
an4.171:5.3: khettaṃ taṃ na hoti, vatthuṃ taṃ na hoti, āyatanaṃ taṃ na hoti, adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ na hoti, yaṃ paccayāssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
an4.171:6.3: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā.
an4.171:6.4: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanā kamati no attasañcetanā.
an4.171:6.5: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā ca kamati parasañcetanā ca.
an4.171:6.6: atthi bhikkhave attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe neva attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā.
an4.171:7.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an4.171:7.2: imassa kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi :
an4.171:7.3: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā. attasañcetanāhetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti.
an4.171:7.4: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanā kamati no attasañcetanā. parasañcetanāhetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti.
an4.171:7.5: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā ca kamati parasañcetanā ca attasañcetanā ca parasañcetanā ca hetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti.
an4.171:7.6: tatra bhante yvāyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe neva attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā. katame tena devā daṭṭhabbāti?
an4.171:8.1: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā āgāmino honti āgantāro itthattaṃ?
an4.171:8.2: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā anāgāmino honti anāgantāro itthattanti?
an4.171:8.3: idha sāriputta ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni appahīnāni honti. so diṭṭheva dhamme nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.171:8.4: so tadassādeti. tannikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
an4.171:8.5: tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī. aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.171:8.6: so tato cuto āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ.
an4.171:9.1: idha pana sāriputta ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni honti. so diṭṭheva dhamme nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.171:9.2: so tadassādeti. tannikāmeti. tena ca cittiṃ āpajjati.
an4.171:9.3: tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃkurumāno nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.171:9.4: so tato cuto anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an4.171:10.1: ayaṃ kho sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā āgāmino honti āgantāro itthattaṃ.
an4.171:10.2: ayaṃ pana sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacce sattā tamhā kāyā cutā anāgāmino honti anāgantāro itthattanti.
